title: Remote login can fail with nonce_mismatch after a correct approval
description: 2026-11-03, Machines on Machines, papyrus 5.72 with cli-login 0.4.0: the first papyrus login --remote was approved and ended with: The sign-in answered tokens for a different request; nothing was saved. A second attempt minutes later succeeded with the same steps. Cause unknown. /cli/challenge answers 404 on this site, so enrollment looks off and the pages should use the CLI's own nonce. The first attempt recorded no diagnostics. A process started shortly before it had been killed before its link was ever shown, so it had no approval. Reproduce and find out why the ID token's nonce differed; the error should also tell the person to start again.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Cause not found. Replay, racing approvals, site_enrolls and the killed process are ruled out by tests or code. Clearer error in 5.83.0 (#1140). Diagnostics are on cli-login develop (DataParade-io/cli-login#19) and need a cli-login release and a pin bump. Keep open until a repeat gives diagnostics.
